## Premium Fraud Management Tools

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/premium-fraud-management-tools/overview): While it is a best practice to configure [Basic Fraud Tools](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/fraud-tools/basic/overview) to protect your account from some…
- [Configuration](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/premium-fraud-management-tools/configuration/): Complete these 3 steps at the same time before you can use Premium Fraud Management Tools: 1.
- [Client-Side Implementation](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/premium-fraud-management-tools/client-side/): To help detect fraud, use `dataCollector` to collect information about a customer's device on your checkout page.
- [Server-Side Implementation](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/premium-fraud-management-tools/server-side/): [best practices guide](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/reference/general/best-practices/ruby)to learn more.
- [Webhooks](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/premium-fraud-management-tools/webhooks/): Fraud Protection webhooks are only available for merchants using Fraud Protection Advanced. For an overview on available Fraud Tools, see our
- [Testing and Go Live](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/premium-fraud-management-tools/testing-go-live/): [best practices guide](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/reference/general/best-practices/ruby)to learn more.
- [Client-Side Implementation](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/premium-fraud-management-tools/client-side/javascript/v3/): To help detect fraud, use `dataCollector` to collect information about a customer's device on your checkout page.
- [Client-Side Implementation](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/premium-fraud-management-tools/client-side/javascript/v2): To help detect fraud, use `dataCollector` to collect information about a customer's device on your checkout page.
- [Server-Side Implementation](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/premium-fraud-management-tools/server-side/ruby): [best practices guide](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/reference/general/best-practices/ruby)to learn more.
